observations.purpose: Ephemeral BTW side-question prompt and sanitized conversation sealed by the BTW entry before provider execution.
Compaction summarizer request (SUMMARIZATION_SYSTEM_PROMPT + serialized transcript). It bypasses the Context Orchestrator, so it is sealed at the stream boundary before transport serialization.
COMPASS pre-reply hybrid-retrieval top-5 facts (get-reply-run extraSystemPromptParts); attributed by content at the seal.
COMPASS self-sustaining-prompt (SSP) produced by buildPreReplyInjection; must run before the bundle seal.
ContextEngine message replacement (attempt.ts assembledMessages swap and ownsCompaction engine loop); must run before the bundle seal.
CVK systemPromptAddition collected into the candidate collection (channel cvk_addition).
DCS knowledge block injection (assembler #appendKnowledge -> knowledge channel).

Attempt system prompt builder (attempt.ts buildAttemptSystemPrompt, provider transform, pre-loop hook overrides); owns every system-prompt byte not attributed to a narrower producer. Its digest is bound at the seal.
Runtime Memory inject-pilot output collected by the Context Orchestrator (memory_pilot channel); must run before the bundle seal.
Role-memory injection in subagent sessions (assembler role_memory handler).
Role Memory ContextPack rendered into a role-spawned subagent system prompt (role-spawn buildRoleSystemPrompt); attributed by content at the seal.
Session-start plan projected through the existing Context Orchestrator candidate collection.

The prompt-cache boundary marker is removed before the bytes leave: stripSystemPromptCacheBoundary in the stream transformContext, joinSystemPromptWithoutCacheBoundary in the OpenAI transports and the provider-owned hand-over, plus the enforceNoOutboundCacheBoundary gate. No semantic text changes.
Provider-specific header injection after the seal; does not touch systemPrompt/messages.
Final wire serialization/stream flag after the seal; does not touch semantic content.
VToken assembly output injected as context candidates.
